findings.finding: The current pipeline compiles 78 of 2375 claims (3.28%); 2268 are rejected by the compiler and 29 by the one-sentence parser interface. No unexpected exception is recorded.
The stored parses compile 79 claims. The two conditions share 76 accepted claims, with identical literal logical forms for all 76; 3 lose acceptance and 2 gain it under the current parser.

For these two UD input conditions, compiler representation/rule coverage is the larger obstacle. This comparison does not evaluate an LLM semantic parser or prove that all parser changes would be ineffective.
The first diagnostics are unhandled content (1060), quantification (487) and missing expected subject structure (238). Diagnostics record the first guard, not every semantic phenomenon in a claim.

Across all 20 accepted development programs, the assistant judges 11 core structures adequate within a tense-agnostic fragment, 2 core structures incorrect and 7 dependent on unspecified semantic contracts. These are not independent human annotations or full-meaning accuracy measurements.

74 accepted current inputs contain a finite tense feature. The compiler predicate families do not add explicit tense/aspect conditions. Core-structure judgments therefore do not certify temporal faithfulness.
91 quantification rejections have a NUM modifier attached to a PROPN head. This structural heuristic is not a count of 91 verified name-handling errors.

The reviewed source-content and abstract-noun programs require a clearer domain/typing contract. Some may be usable with appropriate neural-predicate semantics, but the current programs do not establish that contract.

recommendations.action: Define the semantic representation and compare a frozen text-model semantic parser against this baseline on development claims.
recommendations.success_criterion: Preserve argument identity, lexical compounds, genitive relations, source/content scope and tense/aspect on adjudicated examples; leave ambiguous cases explicit. Measure both coverage and correctness before claiming improvement.

recommendations.action: Extend ordinary argument/modifier coverage and distinguish names, measurements and genuine quantities.
recommendations.success_criterion: Retain locations and complements in examples such as occurred in Myanmar and IM-1 landed on the moon. Do not improve acceptance by deleting constraints.

recommendations.action: Add contrastive tests and explicit event/source/abstract-entity contracts before training relation classifiers.
recommendations.success_criterion: The earthquake genitive is not ownership; martial law remains a lexical unit; depiction/quotation does not silently certify world facts; temporal forms lead to distinct evidence conditions.

recommendations.action: Keep input-form rejection and media-evidence uncertainty separate, and reserve independent sources for later evaluation.
recommendations.success_criterion: Fragments, metadata, multiple sentences and unresolved references have visible diagnostics. Compiler rejection is never scored as a factual refutation or insufficient-evidence prediction.
